description: Upload local files into a file input element (<input type='file'>) or an upload trigger button/menuitem using CDP DOM.setFileInputFiles with automatic MAIN-world DataTransfer synthetic fallback when CDP cannot attach. Supports inline post-upload waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText.

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

files.description: Array of local file paths to upload

selector.description: CSS selector or @ref of the <input type='file'> element or upload trigger button/menuitem

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after uploading

via.description: Upload backend: 'auto' (default, CDP with synthetic DataTransfer fallback), 'cdp' (strict CDP), or 'synthetic' (MAIN-world DataTransfer + File)

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after uploading

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after uploading

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after uploading
